Roughly five connected or closely spaced single-story timber buildings gather around small courtyards and narrow passages. White plaster panels sit between warm brown exposed beams above low brick bases. Wooden lattice windows and doors lie beneath sweeping dark gray tiled roofs, whose raised eaves and decorative ridge ends form an interlocking silhouette. The buildings stay low, rectilinear, and carefully aligned, while their roof orientations vary.

A prominent recessed entry passage holds a heavy double wooden gate, studded with dark metal fittings and ring handles. Around the main cluster stand two or three small detached pavilion-like outbuildings: one isolated beside a long façade and another pair slightly farther away. Bright daylight and soft clouds accompany strong directional shadows. No vegetation, furnishings, people, roads, fences, or surrounding landscape fill the open platform around the architecture.

A large, perfectly flat square of pale gray checkerboard tiles stretches beneath open blue sky, meeting only a distant featureless horizon. Broad empty tiled margins surround a compact, orderly cluster near the platform’s center: a sparse traditional Korean hanok compound.

Roughly five connected or closely spaced single-story timber buildings gather around small courtyards and narrow passages. White plaster panels sit between warm brown exposed beams above low brick bases. Wooden lattice windows and doors lie beneath sweeping dark gray tiled roofs, whose raised eaves and decorative ridge ends form an interlocking silhouette. The buildings stay low, rectilinear, and carefully aligned, while their roof orientations vary.

A prominent recessed entry passage holds a heavy double wooden gate, studded with dark metal fittings and ring handles. Around the main cluster stand two or three small detached pavilion-like outbuildings: one isolated beside a long façade and another pair slightly farther away. Bright daylight and soft clouds accompany strong directional shadows. No vegetation, furnishings, people, roads, fences, or surrounding landscape fill the open platform around the architecture.
